extraction_note: The in-course item is an interactive H5P flashcard deck in a cross-origin iframe; card text was not extractable, so terms below are the chapter's official Key Terms, defined in our own words.
source_note: Study notes summarized in our own words from the GMetrix course player; not verbatim course text.

terms.definition: improving AI-generated content through iterative edits.
the level of detail and precision in a prompt.
tuning a prompt to be neither too broad nor too narrow.
background hints that guide the model's interpretation.
the natural progression of a multi-turn chat with the model.
instructions written so only one interpretation is likely.
explicitly stating the background the model should use.
spelling out exactly what the model must deliver.
not presuming the model knows unstated references.
tuning the role/voice the AI adopts.
assigning the AI a persona (teacher, expert) to shape answers.
sharpening the background information supplied to the model.
giving a few examples so the model learns the pattern.
the model detecting structure/style from examples.
how the model adapts its output based on prompt examples.
a term list supplied to keep translations consistent.
material tailored to a particular field's terminology.
pre-structured formats the model fills in.
anchoring the model in supplied documents/facts.
combining retrieved documents with generation for grounded answers.
the model's use of earlier turns in the same thread.
prompting step-by-step logical reasoning.
asking without providing any examples.
techniques that keep style, facts, and tone steady across outputs.
gathering facts first, then synthesizing them.
linking prompts so each output feeds the next step.
instructing the model what to exclude or avoid.
restricting what the output may contain.
directing the voice and manner of the output.
verifying AI claims against reliable sources.
comparing claims across multiple sources.
reasoning from general principles to specific conclusions.
reasoning from specific observations to general conclusions.
